_text:
Suvarna Projects Limited
Office of the Executive Engineer · West Bengal · IN
No. CC/12/2021/013
Dated: March 31, 2026
CertifiCate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Lift Irrigation — West Bengal Pkg-13” (irrigation), awarded
to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
completed in all respects on June 4, 2021 at a gross executed value of INR 23.20 Cr (Rupees
23.20 Crore Only).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Divya Singh. This certificate is issued for
record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish
past performance.
Executive Engineer
Suvarna Projects Limited
